source.title: Bookin' it Back
source.description: Numi hands over Jurgens' book. With it safely stowed, you begin the long journey back to the other side of the world.
source.objective: Return to the D.E.L.T.A lab with the book Jurgens was looking for.
source.completion: I see you have brought me the book I requested. Excellent! Your service is of profound scientific importance! We're nearly ready to harness geomantic energy and create a stable gateway to another dimension.
